baseline_matching: L4 baseline with as_of_date == feature local_date (no look-ahead)

deviation_class_rule.INSUFFICIENT_BASELINE: baseline maturity is INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY or baseline median is NULL

quantile_position_rule: ordinal band over [Q10,Q25,Q50,Q75,Q90] using half-open intervals [q_low, q_high)
mad_zero_fallback: robust_standardized_deviation is NULL with reason MAD_ZERO when MAD == 0
